baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative joins أَرْبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ to ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ through خَيْرٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse compares two authority architectures: rival lordships divide command among competing centers, while divine oneness concentrates sovereignty in an incomparable power able to overcome every rival. The comparative is practical and relational, not merely numerical.

activation_trace.role: Ownership, mastery, and obeyed sovereignty supply the competing authority centers.
Scattering into parts makes plurality a divided regime rather than a neutral count.
Oneness without partner supplies the noncompetitive center.
Overcoming power from above makes singular authority effective against rival claims.

changed_reading.before: A generic question asking whether many gods or one God is better.
changed_reading.after: A forced comparison between fragmented systems of mastery and one effective, nonrival sovereign, with 'better' demanding a transfer of allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address يَٰصَىٰحِبَىِ ٱلسِّجْنِ places the many-versus-one comparison inside shared confinement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship and prison make the question embodied. People held in one enclosure can still be inwardly distributed among multiple masters; the verse tests whether multiplied allegiances reproduce captivity while singular allegiance reorders it.

activation_trace.role: Sustained accompaniment establishes a shared audience and predicament.
Confinement in a holding place makes authority legible through lived restriction.
Scattering makes rival allegiances an interior and social fragmentation.
Decisive overcoming supplies the power needed to break competing mastery.

changed_reading.before: An abstract statement of monotheism addressed incidentally to prisoners.
changed_reading.after: A prison-situated diagnosis of how divided allegiance itself can be carceral, even before physical release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate answer distinguishes humanly produced names from warranted authority: labels can multiply, but compelling authorization, judgment, and obedient service converge on God. Dispersed lords become a manufactured field of titles whose plurality disguises their lack of governing ground.

activation_trace.role: Mastery supplies the authority claim tested by the following verse.
Scattering supplies the proliferation of claimant authorities.
A name as designation exposes authority produced only at the level of labels.
Compelling proof supplies the missing warrant against which those labels fail.
Judgment locates actual decision authority beyond nominal lordship.
Submissive worship turns the authority test into enacted obedience.

structural_cues: 12:40 follows the question with repeated exclusives: only names, judgment only God's, and worship only Him.
Humans and ancestors perform the naming, while warrant and judgment are assigned elsewhere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-bestowed names, absent warrant, exclusive judgment, and exclusive worship; I infer that dispersion can be generated by multiplying labels while effective authority remains singular. A live alternative is that 12:40 is only a polemical gloss, not a general account of nominal power.

changed_reading.before: Many rival lords are contrasted with one sovereign.
changed_reading.after: The rivals are title-effects: names can proliferate, but governing authority requires warrant, judgment, and deserved obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lord-word moves through human patronage: one prisoner will serve his lord, and Joseph's release depends on remembrance before another lord. Forgetting breaks that mediated chain and confinement continues. The contrast also opposes fragile, distributed patronage to authority not dependent on a subordinate's memory or access.

activation_trace.role: The holding place supplies the concrete consequence when patronage fails.
Overcoming power contrasts with authority mediated through fallible gatekeepers.
A human master receiving service instantiates lordship within a hierarchy.
Repeated human mastery maps Joseph's access route through one patron to another.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure mechanism in the route to release.
Remaining in place supplies the temporal cost of failed patronage.

structural_cues: Human-lord usages follow the divine-lord contrast and lead into a failed remembrance request.
The sequence moves from restoration to service, then from requested intercession to prolonged prison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human masters, a remembrance request, forgetting, and continued imprisonment; I infer a critique of distributed access in which each intermediary is a failure point. A live alternative is that the repeated lord-word is local narrative vocabulary without backward force on 12:39.

changed_reading.before: The many lords are principally false objects of worship.
changed_reading.after: They also appear as a fragile hierarchy of patrons and gatekeepers whose divided agency cannot reliably deliver the prisoner.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plural dream images first appear as a mixed bundle, then become one temporal model: cultivation, consumption, protected reserve, and relief. This activates a hermeneutic reading in which dispersed names signs left unintegrated, while one names a coherent rule ordering them without erasing difference.

activation_trace.role: Distinct aspects supply the many signs that can remain separate or become related.
Union in one direction supplies coherence across distinct elements.
Moving a dream from surface to meaning bridges scattered signs and causal account.
Mixed dreams supply the failed reading in which plurality stays unintelligible.
Sustained effort supplies the first ordered phase of the temporal program.
Protection within an enclosure lets the model answer its destructive phase.

structural_cues: Paired animals and plants repeat in 12:43 and 12:46, then become ordered years in 12:47-49.
Plural experts call the images mixed; Joseph renders one sequence with distinct phases.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixed images, dream-crossing, sustained years, and protected reserve; I infer an analogy between interpretive coherence and the focus's one-versus-dispersed structure. A live alternative is that the sequence demonstrates Joseph's knowledge only.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares competing beings or authorities.
changed_reading.after: It can also compare scattered explanations with one account that makes diverse signs causally and temporally intelligible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence gives singular governance an operational form: grow, enclose, store, guard, and gain capacity over place. Unified authority coordinates dispersed goods across time. Qahhar shifts from bare domination toward power mastering destructive processes in the service of preservation and repair.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply a constructive dimension of lordship.
Coordination in one direction integrates production and reserve across time.
Overcoming power supplies mastery over the consuming sequence.
Cultivation and growth supply the productive input governance coordinates.
Preservation inside a defense supplies resistance to future consumption.
Safekeeping supplies the institutional form of protected reserve.
Watchful guarding supplies the competency maintaining the reserve.
Enablement supplies realized ability to administer across the land.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from cultivation through protected remainder to treasuries and territorial capacity.
Destructive years consume prior provision, so rule must bind separated times and resources into one plan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation, enclosure, storage, guarding, and enablement; I infer that these operationalize constructive singular mastery and revise the valence of overcoming power. A live alternative is that this administration is only a human response under divine mercy.

changed_reading.before: The One-Qahhar is better because singular force defeats rivals.
changed_reading.after: The One-Qahhar can also be heard as undivided capacity overcoming scarcity by coordinating nurture, storage, and preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph triggers inquiry before release; separate testimonies converge until truth becomes manifest and he is publicly cleared. Oneness is activated juridically, not as silencing many voices but as their convergence under reality that overcomes intrigue.

activation_trace.role: Separation and distinction supply initially distributed claims and witnesses.
Convergence in one direction supplies agreement without erasing speakers.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the process gathering separated accounts.
The appearance of truth supplies the point of convergence.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the governing standard.
Purification from admixture supplies the social result of inquiry.

structural_cues: The king's summons is interrupted by Joseph's demand for inquiry, followed by several testimonies.
Public clearing precedes private audience and appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, multiple testimonies, manifest truth, and purification; I infer that one governing truth coordinates rather than suppresses differentiated evidence. A live alternative is that this is solely narrative vindication.

changed_reading.before: Oneness opposes plural authorities by replacing them.
changed_reading.after: Oneness may also name the truthful order under which dispersed voices become answerable and converge on what occurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The return of خَيْرٌ at the window's close, now predicating hereafter reward, changes the comparison's metric. Better is not settled by present effectiveness; it is evaluated across ultimate recompense, trust, and guarded conduct.

activation_trace.role: Choice of the better supplies the open question later reweighted.
Recompense for work supplies the outcome judging the earlier preference.
Lateness after what comes first extends evaluation beyond the visible present.
Beneficial good repeats the comparator and supplies its ethical horizon.
Placing oneself within protection supplies conduct aligned with the better outcome.

structural_cues: The same comparative lexeme occurs in 12:39 and 12:57.
The second follows visible empowerment yet declares later reward better for those who trust and guard themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition, later recompense, trust, and self-protection; I infer that 12:57 reaches backward and widens 12:39 beyond immediate dominance. A live alternative is that the final comparison is an independent maxim.

changed_reading.before: Better means the more coherent and powerful object of present allegiance.
changed_reading.after: Better also means the allegiance whose benefit survives the present order and is disclosed by ultimate recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و mapping and a botanical ف ر ق branch rather than ordinary sovereignty senses. It remains anchored in أَرْبَابٌ and مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ and is activated by local cultivation and rain. Downstream prose should call it a formative ecological analogy, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping for أَرْبَابٌ permits nourishment and growth, while مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ permits discontinuous vegetation.

activation_trace.role: Feeding and growth supply a form-distant image of lordships as formative regimes.
Patchy vegetation supplies the material image of formation dispersed among rival growers.
Cultivation makes the formative analogy locally active.
Life-giving rain supplies a common condition under which growth revives.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks which sovereigns should be obeyed.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, it can ask which formative ecology is better: patchy growth under rival cultivators or formation coordinated toward one source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material branch in which heat transforms flesh and aligns it with repeated pressing. It remains anchored in ٱلْقَهَّارُ, prison, and مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ, but the direction is analogical. Downstream prose must not translate Qahhar as cooking or pressing; it may only note directed pressure releasing latent yield.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The material branch of ٱلْقَهَّارُ sits beside confinement and dispersed masters, while pressing frames the first dream and the year of relief.

activation_trace.role: Severity fixed like confinement supplies the sustained pressure field.
Heat drawing out liquid and changing material supplies the strange transformative image.
Pressure until liquid is expressed supplies the prisoner's latent-yield image.
Pressing in the relief year supplies a transformed endpoint to earlier pressure.

changed_reading.before: Qahhar names superior coercive force over rival lords.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified material activation, singular qahr becomes directed pressure bringing a latent outcome forth, unlike scattered pressures.

strongest_changes: 12:40 turns dispersed lordships into proliferated names lacking warrant, while judgment and worship remain singular.
12:41-42 makes human lordship a fragile patronage chain whose failure prolongs confinement.
The dream and provisioning sequence activates unified interpretation and preservative rule.
The repeated خَيْرٌ in 12:57 widens the comparison from present effectiveness to ultimate recompense.
summary.what_was_special: The focus question remained simultaneously theological, carceral, political, hermeneutic, juridical, and temporal. The split ر ب ب mapping and material ق ه ر branch also sustained two contained surprises: an ecology of formation and a pressure-to-yield analogy.
remaining_uncertainties: The dream, inquiry, and provisioning sequences may activate 12:39 analogically rather than deliberately.
Preservative or liberative valences of ٱلْقَهَّارُ depend on reader-supplied direction and cannot displace its overcoming sense.
The recurrence of خَيْرٌ in 12:57 may reweight the focus or function as a local closing maxim.
